mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_documents ( name, category, file_name, content, content_embedding, file_size, content_type, storage_key, storage_url, vector_status, vector_error, chunk_count, question_count, access_count, uploaded_at, processed_at, last_accessed_at, parent_id, chunk_index ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{category}, #{fileName}, #{content}, #{contentEmbedding}::vector, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{storageKey}, #{storageUrl}, #{vectorStatus}, #{vectorError}, #{chunkCount}, #{questionCount}, #{accessCount}, #{uploadedAt}, #{processedAt}, #{lastAccessedAt}, #{parentId}, #{chunkIndex} )
mapper.select: SELECT *, (content_embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector) AS similarity_score FROM knowledge_documents WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY similarity_score ASC LIMIT #{limit}
